x-m-el-cul-01.title: Shin katin kuɗi da gaske ‘rabo na zinariya’ ne?
x-m-el-cul-01.topic: Rabo, daidaituwa, da tsari a fasaha da rayuwar yau da kullum
x-m-el-cul-01.goal: Yi lissafin rabobi ka kwatanta da wani iƙirari, sannan ka saita ma’auninka na bambancin da za a amince da shi kafin a ce ‘rabo na zinariya ne.’
x-m-el-cul-01.material: Wani rubutu a shafin yanar gizo ya ce: ‘Katin kuɗi murabba’i ne mai girman 85.6mm da 53.98mm, kuma rabon gefensa mai tsawo da gajere shi ne rabo na zinariya.’ Rabo na zinariya shi ne (1 da aka ƙara wa tushen murabba’i na 5) a raba da 2, wato kusan 1.618. Girman (gefe mai tsawo : gefe mai gajere) na abubuwan da za a kwatanta su ne kamar haka: takardar A4 297mm : 210mm, katin wasiƙa 148mm : 100mm, da allon na’ura mai rabon 16 zuwa 10, 16 : 10.
x-m-el-cul-01.thinking.0: Tantance iƙirari ta amfani da hujja (rabobi da aka ƙididdige)
x-m-el-cul-01.thinking.1: Saita da amfani da ma’aunin haƙuri
x-m-el-cul-01.prereq.0: Nemo rabon tsawo biyu ta hanyar rabawa (matakin makarantar sakandare)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.prompt: Kana son tantance jimlar shafin yanar gizo cewa ‘katin kuɗi murabba’i ne na rabo na zinariya.’ Raba gefen mai tsawo da gajere, sannan ka zaɓi mafi kyawun tantancewa.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.hint.0: Raba gefen mai tsawo da na gajere, sannan ka rubuta wannan ƙima kusa da 1.618.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin daban ko ƙimomin biyu ‘daidai’ ne da kuma ‘yawan bambancinsu.’
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.a: Matsakaicin rabo 1.586 yana zagayawa zuwa 1.6, saboda haka za a iya cewa daidai yake da rabo na zinariya
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.a: Kana amfani da ƙimar da aka zagaya don ta yi kama a matsayin hujjar ‘daidaito.’ Ka duba yadda ƙarshe zai canza gwargwadon yawan lambobin da ka zagaya.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.b: 1.586 da 1.618 sun bambanta, saboda haka katin kuɗi ba shi da alaƙa ko kaɗan da rabo na zinariya
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.b: Ka raba shi zuwa ‘daidai / ba daidai ko kaɗan’ kawai. Ba ka yi la’akari da girman bambancin ba.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.c: Rabon kusan 1.586 ne, wanda ya bambanta da 1.618, saboda haka kalmar ‘kusa’ ita ce mafi dacewa
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.c: Ka kwatanta ƙimar da aka lissafa da ƙimar iƙirari, sannan ka bambance ‘daidai’ da ‘kusa.’
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.d: Rabo da aka auna da mm yana canzawa idan an mayar da shi cm, saboda haka ba za a iya kwatanta ƙimomin ba
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.d: Kana tsammanin rabo yana canzawa idan raka’a ta canza. Ka duba abin da ke faruwa ga rabon tsawo biyu da aka auna da raka’a ɗaya idan aka sauya raka’ar.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.explain: 85.6÷53.98 kusan 1.586 ne, wanda ya bambanta da rabo na zinariya 1.618 da kusan 2%. A irin wannan yanayi, ‘kusa da rabo na zinariya’ magana ce ta gaskiya fiye da ‘daidai rabo na zinariya.’
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.prompt: Ka saita ma’auni: ‘Idan gefen mai tsawo ÷ gefen gajere ya bambanta da 1.618 da ƙasa da 3%, yana kusa da rabo na zinariya.’ Zaɓi duk abubuwan da za a iya kira kusa. (3% na 1.618 kusan 0.049 ne.)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.hint.0: Mayar da rabon kowane abu zuwa adadin goma.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.hint.1: Cire 0.049 daga 1.618, sannan ka ƙara masa 0.049 don nemo zangon da aka yarda da shi da kanka; daga nan ka duba ko kowane rabo yana cikin zangon.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.o.a: Takardar A4 (gefe mai tsawo 297mm : gefe mai gajere 210mm)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.a: Ka sake duba yadda ka karanta bambancin yayin nemo rabo da kwatanta shi da ma’auni. Ka ƙididdige ko bambancin wannan ƙima da 1.618 yana cikin zangon da aka yarda da shi.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.b: Ka nemo rabon, sannan ka kwatanta bambancinsa da 1.618 da zangon da aka yarda da shi.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.o.c: Katin wasiƙa (gefe mai tsawo 148mm : gefe mai gajere 100mm)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.c: Ka sake dubawa ko da kanka ka lissafa bambancin rabon katin wasiƙa da 1.618, ka ga ko yana cikin zangon da aka yarda da shi. Jin cewa suna kama idan an kalla ya bambanta da kwatantawa da ma’auni.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.d: Ka mayar da 16÷10 zuwa adadin goma, sannan ka kwatanta da ma’auni.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.explain: Katin kuɗi kaɗai, 1.586 (bambanci kusan 2.0%), da allon na’ura, 1.6 (kusan 1.1%), suna cikin 3%. Takardar A4 kusan 1.414 (kusan 12.6%) ce, katin wasiƙa kuma 1.48 (kusan 8.5%); duka suna wajen zangon.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.prompt: Haƙuri (a nan 3%) ma’auni ne da na saita. Rubuta a jimloli ɗaya ko biyu dalilin da ya sa dole ne a saita haƙuri kafin a ce ‘rabo na zinariya ne,’ da abin da za a lura da shi yayin saita ma’aunin.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko, rubuta a jimla ɗaya dalilin da ya sa hukunci ba tare da ma’auni ba matsala ce.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin abin da zai faru da takardar A4 da katin wasiƙa idan ka saita ma’aunin ya zama babba sosai (misali, 20%).
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka ba da dalilin cewa ƙimar ‘daidai iri ɗaya’ kusan ba ta taɓa kasancewa a zahiri?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta abin da zai faru idan ma’aunin ya yi girma ko ƙanƙanta sosai?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya bayyana yadda katin kuɗi da katin wasiƙa suka bambanta bisa ma’auninka?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.model.0: Ƙimomin da aka auna koyaushe suna da kuskure, kuma ma’aunin tsawo ba cikakke ba ne, saboda haka ƙimomi daidai ɗaya kusan ba sa faruwa. Saboda haka da farko saita haƙuri kamar 1% ko 3%, sannan ka ce yana kusa idan yana cikin wannan zangon. Idan ka saita ma’aunin ya yi girma sosai, kusan kowane murabba’i zai zama rabo na zinariya.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.model.1: Murabba’i mai ƙimar daidai 1.618 kusan ba ya samuwa a zahiri, saboda haka dole ne a saita zangon kamar cikin 5%. Amma idan zangon ya zama 10%, katin wasiƙa (bambanci kusan 8.5%) ma zai shiga, don haka ma’aunin ya yi sassauci sosai.

x-m-el-cul-02.title: Nemo layin da ba daidai ba a teburin daidaituwa

Siffa mai daidaituwar layi tana da layin daidaituwa, wato layin da idan aka ninka siffar a kansa sassan biyu za su rufe juna daidai; siffa mai daidaituwar tsakiya kuma tana rufe kanta idan aka juya ta rabin juyawa (180°) a wani wuri. Ɗaya daga cikin layukan teburin yana da kuskure.

x-m-el-cul-02.thinking.2: Zaɓi siffofin da suka cika sharadin

x-m-el-cul-02.prereq.1: Siffofi da halayen murabba’i mai kusurwa huɗu, lu’u-lu’u, da daidaitattun gefuna biyu-biyu

x-m-el-cul-03.material: A kan jeren tubalan shimfida 100, ana jera tubalan ja da shuɗi a madadin juna. Ana ɗaukar tsarin ‘tubalan ja r, sai tubalan shuɗi (p−r)’ a matsayin rukuni ɗaya, sannan a maimaita shi. Sharuddan su ne: (1) p lamba ce ta halitta daga 2 zuwa 50, r kuma lamba ce ta halitta daga 1 har ƙasa da p. (2) Ba a yanke rukunin ƙarshe, tubalan 100 kuma suna ƙare daidai a ƙarshen rukuni. (3) Akwai tubalan ja 40 daidai (40% na jimillar).
